name: Music Library
install:
set -e
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm install 24 >/dev/null 2>&1
nvm alias default 24 >/dev/null 2>&1
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"
node -v
[ -f .env ] || { cp .env.example .env && echo 'SITE_URL="http://localhost:3000"' >> .env; }
npm ci
npx prisma migrate deploy
npx prisma generate --sql
NEED_SEED=$(node -e "try{const D=require('better-sqlite3');const db=new D('data.db',{readonly:true});const r=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM User').get();db.close();process.stdout.write(r.c>0?'no':'yes')}catch(e){process.stdout.write('yes')}")
if [ "$NEED_SEED" = "yes" ]; then echo 'Seeding database'; npx prisma db seed; else echo 'DB already seeded, skipping'; fi
start:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"
[ -f .env ] || { cp .env.example .env && echo 'SITE_URL="http://localhost:3000"' >> .env; }
npx prisma migrate deploy
NEED_SEED=$(node -e "try{const D=require('better-sqlite3');const db=new D('data.db',{readonly:true});const r=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM User').get();db.close();process.stdout.write(r.c>0?'no':'yes')}catch(e){process.stdout.write('yes')}")
if [ "$NEED_SEED" = "yes" ]; then echo 'Seeding database'; npx prisma db seed; fi

terminals.name: Dev Server
terminals.command:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"
npm run dev
terminals.description: Runs the Music Library dev server (React Router + MSW mocks) on http://localhost:3000. Log in with kody / kodylovesyou.
